name: com.gog.sdk
description: GOG auto sign-in SDK — Android and iOS (SSO code exchange + session lifecycle). Bundles the native Android core .aar and its Gradle dependencies; the iOS core (GOG.xcframework) ships in Runtime/Plugins/iOS.

samples.description: The complete recommended integration in one file: initialize, the boot rule (CurrentSession + events), Sign in with GOG, the shared coin wallet, and the GogResult error pattern.
